```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "
    <!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity'>
    <!NOTATION png SYSTEM 'image/png'>
    <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM 'logo.png' NDATA png>
  ">
  %param;
]>
<?target data-processing-instruction?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing special characters & <xml/> -->
  <sub:child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with <tags> and &entities; inside ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseValue">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; Extended">
  <!NOTATION ntu SYSTEM "application/x-ntu">
  <!ENTITY binfile "data.bin" NDATA ntu>
  <!ENTITY % ext-dtd SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  %ext-dtd;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Header comment for parsing verification -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Multi-line CDATA section with entity reference &derived;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&derived;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record+)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Second Entity">
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>">
  %pEnt;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc "document.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" mode="verbose"?>
<archive xmlns="http://schema.example.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://schema.example.org/meta">
  <!-- First comment block -->
  <meta:info>
    <![CDATA[ Metadata CDATA block with <content> ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <!-- Second comment block -->
  <record>&ent2;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY name "Widget">
  <!ENTITY desc "&name; is a high quality item.">
  <!NOTATION tiff SYSTEM "image/tiff">
  <!ENTITY pic "photo.tiff" NDATA tiff>
  <!ENTITY % markup "<!ATTLIST product code ID #REQUIRED>">
  %markup;
]>
<?xml-app-pi param="value"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.example.com" xmlns:ns="http://inventory.example.com/ns">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment explaining schema constraints -->
  <product code="p001" ns:status="active">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw description data containing unparsed tags: <product>&name;</product>
    ]]>
  </product>
  <product code="p002">&desc;</product>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY beta "α Beta">
  <!ENTITY gamma "β Gamma">
  <!NOTATION svg SYSTEM "image/svg+xml">
  <!ENTITY graphic "image.svg" NDATA svg>
  <!ENTITY % macroDefs "
    <!ENTITY nestedEnt 'NestedEntityContent'>
  ">
  %macroDefs;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="renderer" data="type='vector'"?>
<document xmlns="http://doc.example.net" xmlns:ref="http://doc.example.net/ref">
  <!-- Complex comment enclosing markup-like text: <section> -->
  <ref:section ref:id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA segment with entity: γ and &nestedEnt;
    ]]>
  </ref:section>
  <section>γ</section>
</document>
```
